for p in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016 18020 18024; do

  code2=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 http://localhost:$p/healthz 2>/dev/null)
